d: Elon Musk is one of the most influential and culturally relevant individuals on the planet – not to mention the wealthiest. He also spent nearly half a billion dollars trying to help Republicans in this month's midterm elections, only to watch Democrats take control of both chambers of Congress. Now, the world's richest man is trying to distance himself from the movement he bankrolled, and President Donald Trump doesn't appear to be thrilled about it.
